soru: Çok kipli büyük dil modelleriyle çalışan çoklu robot ağlarında algılama, haberleşme ve hesaplamanın birlikte ele alınması üzerine en önemli çalışmalar ve açık problemler neler?
istem:
Research question: Çok kipli büyük dil modelleriyle çalışan çoklu robot ağlarında algılama, haberleşme ve hesaplamanın birlikte ele alınması üzerine en önemli çalışmalar ve açık problemler neler?

Cutoff date: 2026-02-28. Only works published BEFORE this date count.

List the 30 most important works (papers) for this research question that were published before the cutoff date, in order of importance (most important first) — the kind a careful expert survey published right after the cutoff would cite. Give each with its arXiv id and/or DOI.

You MUST research this with web search rather than answer from memory: search for the important works, and verify each listed work's title, publication date and identifier on the web (e.g. arxiv.org, doi.org, the publisher or DBLP page) before including it.

When you are done, reply with ONLY a JSON object in this form (no other text):
{"calismalar": [{"sira": 1, "baslik": "exact title", "yil": 2020, "arxiv_id": "arXiv id or null", "doi": "DOI or null", "gerekce": "one sentence on why this work is important"}]}
with exactly 30 items. If you do not know an identifier, use null instead of guessing.

calismalar.baslik: Large Language Models for Multi-Robot Systems: A Survey
calismalar.gerekce: Presented as the first dedicated survey of LLMs in multi-robot systems; it sorts the field into task allocation, motion planning, action generation and human intervention, and covers open problems such as latency and hallucination.

calismalar.baslik: A Survey on Integrated Sensing, Communication, and Computation
calismalar.gerekce: The core survey on jointly designing sensing, communication and computation (ISCC), covering signal design and resource management; it underpins the network side of this question.

calismalar.baslik: RoCo: Dialectic Multi-Robot Collaboration with Large Language Models
calismalar.gerekce: Robots equipped with LLMs coordinate by talking to each other in natural language and plan both sub-tasks and paths; the paper also introduces the RoCoBench benchmark.

calismalar.baslik: PaLM-E: An Embodied Multimodal Language Model
calismalar.gerekce: Introduced the embodied multimodal LLM idea by feeding sensor observations directly into a language model's embedding space.

calismalar.baslik: Scalable Multi-Robot Collaboration with Large Language Models: Centralized or Decentralized Systems?
calismalar.gerekce: Compares centralized, decentralized and hybrid communication architectures for LLM-based multi-robot planning and shows how each trades off scalability against communication.

calismalar.baslik: SMART-LLM: Smart Multi-Agent Robot Task Planning using Large Language Models
calismalar.gerekce: Uses LLMs for task decomposition, coalition formation and task allocation in multi-robot teams, with a benchmark.

calismalar.baslik: Building Cooperative Embodied Agents Modularly with Large Language Models
calismalar.gerekce: CoELA: a modular agent architecture with perception, memory, communication and planning modules, which showed that effective communication emerges among embodied LLM agents.

calismalar.baslik: Pushing Large Language Models to the 6G Edge: Vision, Challenges, and Opportunities
calismalar.gerekce: Sets out a 6G MEC vision for running LLMs through split inference, quantization and end-edge cooperation, which is central to the computation side of the question.

calismalar.baslik: Large Language Models Empowered Autonomous Edge AI for Connected Intelligence
calismalar.gerekce: Proposes a system in which LLMs coordinate edge AI models, combining task-oriented communication with federated learning.

calismalar.baslik: Integrated Sensing and Edge AI: Realizing Intelligent Perception in 6G
calismalar.gerekce: A survey of the task-oriented ISEA paradigm, which co-designs sensing, communication and AI computation at the edge.

calismalar.baslik: Large Language Model-Driven Distributed Integrated Multimodal Sensing and Semantic Communications
calismalar.gerekce: LLM-DiSAC: combines RF and camera fusion across distributed sensing devices with LLM-based semantic transmission, directly linking multimodal sensing, communication and computation.

calismalar.baslik: Mobile Edge Intelligence for Large Language Models: A Contemporary Survey
calismalar.gerekce: A broad survey of caching, training and inference for LLMs at the edge.

calismalar.baslik: COHERENT: Collaboration of Heterogeneous Multi-Robot System with Large Language Models
calismalar.gerekce: A hierarchical LLM planner for heterogeneous teams of quadrotors, robot dogs and robot arms, built on a proposal-execution-feedback-adjustment loop.

calismalar.baslik: Large AI Model Empowered Multimodal Semantic Communications
calismalar.gerekce: LAM-MSC: a framework that uses multimodal large models for semantic extraction and recovery in communication.

calismalar.baslik: Large Multi-Modal Models (LMMs) as Universal Foundation Models for AI-Native Wireless Systems
calismalar.gerekce: A vision for wireless-specific LMMs that process multimodal sensing data and ground their outputs in real wireless systems.

calismalar.baslik: When Robotics Meets Wireless Communications: An Introductory Tutorial
calismalar.gerekce: The core tutorial connecting robotics and wireless communication through problems such as communication-aware trajectory planning.

calismalar.baslik: Do As I Can, Not As I Say: Grounding Language in Robotic Affordances
calismalar.gerekce: SayCan: grounds LLM plans in robot affordances and laid the groundwork for LLM-based robot planning.

calismalar.baslik: RT-2: Vision-Language-Action Models Transfer Web Knowledge to Robotic Control
calismalar.gerekce: Introduced the vision-language-action (VLA) model paradigm and moved web-scale knowledge into robot control.

calismalar.baslik: OpenVLA: An Open-Source Vision-Language-Action Model
calismalar.gerekce: An open-source VLA model and a key reference point for deploying multimodal models on robots and edge hardware.

calismalar.baslik: Integrated Sensing and Communications: Towards Dual-functional Wireless Networks for 6G and Beyond
calismalar.gerekce: The foundational ISAC survey that underpins the joint sensing-communication design in robot networks.

calismalar.baslik: Deep Learning Enabled Semantic Communication Systems
calismalar.gerekce: DeepSC: the foundational deep-learning semantic communication system, the basis for transmitting meaning between robots.

calismalar.baslik: Learning Task-Oriented Communication for Edge Inference: An Information Bottleneck Approach
calismalar.gerekce: Introduced task-oriented feature transmission for edge inference using an information bottleneck approach.

calismalar.baslik: Where2comm: Communication-Efficient Collaborative Perception via Spatial Confidence Maps
calismalar.gerekce: A landmark multi-agent collaborative perception method that optimizes the perception-bandwidth trade-off.

calismalar.baslik: EdgeShard: Efficient LLM Inference via Collaborative Edge Computing
calismalar.gerekce: Splits an LLM across distributed edge devices by jointly optimizing device selection and model partitioning.

calismalar.baslik: Embodied LLM Agents Learn to Cooperate in Organized Teams
calismalar.gerekce: Shows that organizational structure and leadership among embodied LLM agents cut communication overhead and improve team efficiency.

calismalar.baslik: Large Model Enabled Embodied Intelligence for 6G Integrated Perception, Communication, and Computation Network
calismalar.gerekce: Presents a large-model-based embodied intelligence architecture for a 6G network that integrates perception, communication and computation, along with an evaluation framework.

calismalar.baslik: Large Language Model based Multi-Agents: A Survey of Progress and Challenges
calismalar.gerekce: A broad survey of communication and coordination mechanisms in LLM-based multi-agent systems.

calismalar.baslik: Code as Policies: Language Model Programs for Embodied Control
calismalar.gerekce: Introduced generating robot policies as code with LLMs, a pattern adopted widely in multi-robot planners.

calismalar.baslik: π0: A Vision-Language-Action Flow Model for General Robot Control
calismalar.gerekce: A general-purpose robot control model based on flow matching and one of the leading VLA models.

calismalar.baslik: Task-Oriented Communication for Multi-Device Cooperative Edge Inference
calismalar.gerekce: Extends task-oriented communication to multi-device cooperative inference, which fits the multi-robot sensing-fusion setting directly.
